---
title: Radish and Tuna Salad with Pine Nuts
id: MAR-0063
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g tuna in oil
- 100 g radish
- 40 g pine nuts
- 4 slices of country bread
- 2 tablespoons chopped parsley
- 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Toast the pine nuts in a non-stick pan without fat, moving it occasionally by the handle.
2. Wash the radishes, slice them and put in a large bowl; season with salt, pepper and 2 tablespoons of oil, then mix.
3. Divide the bread slices in half and then in half again.
4. Oil the bread and toast under the oven grill for a few minutes.
5. Meanwhile drain the tuna, crumble it and sprinkle over the radishes.
6. Add the pine nuts, parsley and serve with the toasted bread.
